evidence.title: GitHub - microsoft/VibeVoice: Open-Source Frontier Voice AI

name: VibeVoice
summary: Open-source voice AI models for long-form speech recognition and multi-speaker text-to-speech, plus a realtime streaming model.
description: Microsoft's open-source family of voice AI models. VibeVoice-ASR transcribes up to 60 minutes of audio in a single pass, labelling who said what and when across 50+ languages; VibeVoice-TTS synthesizes up to 90 minutes of speech with up to 4 distinct speakers; VibeVoice-Realtime-0.5B streams text-to-speech with roughly 300 ms first-audio latency. Weights, finetuning code and vLLM inference are provided; the models are intended for research and development.
contains: VibeVoice-ASR: 60-minute single-pass transcription with who/when/what labels
ASR supports 50+ languages and custom hotwords
VibeVoice-TTS: up to 90 minutes of speech with 4 speakers
VibeVoice-Realtime-0.5B streams TTS at ~300 ms first-audio latency
weights on Hugging Face plus finetuning and vLLM inference code
